meta.title: The Windy Night at May's House

paragraphs: It is a windy night, and Lily sleeps at May's house. Pip sleeps next to her bed. May's pet rabbit sits in its cage near the door. Outside, the rain is very loud. Pat comes into the room and sits on the bed. "I can't sleep," he says. "I'm afraid of the wind." Pip is afraid too, and he hides under the bed.

May looks at Pat and smiles. "Don't be afraid," she says. "Let's look at the world outside." The three children go to the window quietly. The rabbit watches them from its cage. The trees wave in the wind. Leaves fly around the garden. "Are the trees angry?" asks Pat. "No, they say hello to the wind," says May.

Then the rain stops, and the wind is quiet. Now all the stars are in the sky. Pat is very quiet. He looks at the night. "Is the rabbit afraid?" he asks. "No," says May. "It is a brave rabbit, like you." "Am I brave?" asks Pat. "Yes, you looked at the night," says Lily. Pat waves at the stars and says, "Good night!" Pip comes out from under the bed and says, "Woof!"
